purpose: Evidence for a distinct cassava breeding, UAV phenotyping and clonal multiplication simulation paper in IAS_Cassava/paper_cassava_review.
search_scope: Targeted primary/official-source assessment, not a systematic literature review. Academic MCP was unavailable; public publisher, institutional and registry sources were used.

sources.title: NCBI cassava assembly and annotation records
anchors: Assemblies; Annotation Release information
NCBI Datasets JSON: organism.infraspecific_names; assembly_info; assembly_stats; organelle_info
sources.assessment_scope: Official v8 API fields, Annotation Release 100/101 tables and legacy v6 assembly-report header assessed. Legacy v6 direct API returned an empty object.
permitted_claims: AM560-2 v8 is GCF_001659605.2, paired GCA_001659605.2; the v6 accession has version .1.
The v8 record represents a haploid reference and lists 18 nuclear chromosomes plus chloroplast and mitochondrion.
limits: Assembly representation is not biological ploidy. Do not count organelles as nuclear chromosomes or mix coordinate/annotation versions.

sources.title: The haplotype-resolved chromosome pairs of a heterozygous diploid African cassava cultivar reveal novel pan-genome and allele-specific transcriptome features
anchors: Analyses: Phased, haplotype-resolved contigs; Pseudochromosome pairs; Table 3
Data Availability
NCBI taxon-3983 dataset_report: TME204 assembly_name, bioproject_accession and linked_assemblies
sources.assessment_scope: Selected assembly analyses, Table 3 text and data availability assessed; NCBI assembly identities cross-checked.
permitted_claims: TME204 is a heterozygous diploid cultivar represented by two phased haplotypes with 18 pseudochromosomes each.
H1 corresponds to PRJNA758616 and H2 to PRJNA758615; registry assembly names resolve the GCA identities.
limits: H1/H2 are not two cultivars or evidence of tetraploidy. BioProject IDs are not assembly accessions. Genome resources do not establish agronomic superiority in Vietnam.

sources.title: Marker-Based Estimates Reveal Significant Nonadditive Effects in Clonally Propagated Cassava (Manihot esculenta): Implications for the Prediction of Total Genetic Value and the Selection of Varieties
anchors: Methods: Germplasm and phenotyping trials
Results: Partitioning the genetic variance
Discussion, opening paragraphs
sources.assessment_scope: Selected methods, model-comparison and discussion excerpts assessed, sufficient for breeding-value versus clonal-value distinction.
permitted_claims: IITA/NextGen data support modelling additive and nonadditive effects separately.
Nonadditive model benefit differed by trait; root-yield results did not generalise to dry matter.
limits: Use additive parent merit and clonal total genetic value as distinct targets. A+D is a reduced model when epistasis is omitted; no study variance component is imported into the simulation.

sources.title: Genomic mating in outbred species: predicting cross usefulness with additive and total genetic covariance matrices
anchors: Genomic mate selection for outbred, clonal crops
Cassava data: traits, trials, and selection indices
Parent-wise cross-validation scheme
Caveats, limitations, and future directions
sources.assessment_scope: Selected mate-selection formulation, target traits, parent-wise validation and limitations assessed.
permitted_claims: Cross usefulness can target additive breeding value or total genetic value.
Parent-wise validation excluded descendants of held-out parents from marker-effect training while retaining the phenotyped parents.
limits: Predicted family distributions and usefulness are not realised selection gain. Phasing, pedigree and marker density constrain application. No local covariance matrix or index weights are supplied.

sources.title: Improving root characterisation for genomic prediction in cassava
anchors: Materials and methods: Image acquisition; Image processing and phenotype acquisition
Genomic prediction
Results: Genomic prediction; Figures 5–6 captions
sources.assessment_scope: Harvested-root image acquisition and genomic-prediction methods/results assessed; figure captions read without visual inspection.
permitted_claims: Root size/shape images came from harvested roots arranged separately on a calibrated board.
The paper assessed genomic prediction of image-derived root traits with repeated fivefold partitions.
limits: This is harvested-root photography, not UAV observation through soil. Root yield, shape and chemical quality remain separately observed traits.

sources.title: Machine learning for high-throughput field phenotyping and image processing provides insight into the association of above and below-ground traits in cassava (Manihot esculenta Crantz)
anchors: Materials and methods: Experimental site and trial conditions; Ground-truth measurements
Dataset preparation; Assessing the quality of the model
Results: Cassava root yield predictions using ML models; Tables 1, 4
sources.assessment_scope: Experimental design, harvest references, field-repetition holdout and Table 4 text assessed.
permitted_claims: CIAT Pheno-i estimated canopy features from UAV imagery in two Colombian trials with four contrasting genotypes.
Root biomass was weighed at harvest; the ML test held out one field repetition.
limits: Canopy-based root-yield prediction is a proxy calibrated against harvest. The test does not establish transfer to new genotypes, Vietnam sites or future years; R-squared must not become a universal sensor-error variance.

sources.title: BASICS: Breeder Seed Component
anchors: Breeder Seed Component; Semi-Autotropic Hydroponics; Go-Seed
Classes of Seed: Breeder, Foundation, Certified Seeds
sources.assessment_scope: Official public page text assessed. Subsequent page access returned HTTP 401; no restriction was bypassed.
permitted_claims: IITA/NRCRI breeder material feeds traceable foundation and commercial/certified vegetative-seed production.
SAH and GoSeed support early-generation multiplication and links with private producers.
limits: These are Nigerian programme/class descriptions, not Vietnamese certification rules. No fixed multiplication ratio or stage duration is transferred.

sources.title: BASICS: Quality Seed Component
anchors: Quality Seed Component: certification at Breeder/Foundation/Certified levels
Molecular diagnostics for CMD/CBSD; Cassava Seed Tracker
sources.assessment_scope: Official public quality-component description assessed. Subsequent access returned HTTP 401.
permitted_claims: Planting-material identity, regulated certification, molecular diagnostic capability and traceability are separate controls.
limits: Reported project intentions are not proof that every lot was tested or certified. A canopy disease label is not a laboratory-negative result. Nigerian pest context is not a Vietnam prevalence claim.

sources.title: Alliance Bioversity International-CIAT: Colombia Genebank
anchors: Cassava collection: pathogen-negative indexing, distribution and accompanying documents
sources.assessment_scope: Cassava-section official page/excerpts assessed; a later page request timed out.
permitted_claims: The cassava collection distributes pathogen-indexed material with a health statement, phytosanitary certificate and Standard Material Transfer Agreement.
limits: A genebank health statement is distinct from commercial certification. Record tested pathogens, method and date; do not interpret indexed material as universally free of all pathogens.

sources.title: NextGen Cassava: Project Structure & Objectives
anchors: Breeding Division
Research Division
Survey Division
sources.assessment_scope: Official project divisions and their stated roles assessed.
permitted_claims: NextGen combines breeding/clonal testing, genomic prediction, Cassavabase and product-profile research.
CIAT/Embrapa pre-breeding and phytosanitary/international-nursery roles are distinguished from variety-release breeding.
limits: Programme organisation supplies a workflow precedent, not fixed Vietnamese stages, durations, costs or realised gains.

reference_genomes.status: Legacy accession, annotation release 100; RefSeq/GenBank pair verified in the official archived assembly report.
Official registry identity assessed; no FASTA/GFF download or coordinate liftover performed.

claim_map.claim: Model cultivated cassava as a diploid with n=18, 2n=36; a phased assembly has two haplotypes of the same cultivar.
claim_map.support: Primary diploid assembly and 18 chromosome-pair table, independently matched to registry identities.
claim_map.scope_limit: Not every Manihot accession or induced polyploid; no direct karyotyping in this project.

claim_map.claim: Separate additive merit for choosing crossing parents from total clonal value for choosing a vegetatively multiplied variety.
claim_map.support: Primary cassava genomic models distinguish breeding value and total genetic value.
claim_map.scope_limit: If the simulator uses A+D, label omitted epistasis and target population/environment; do not equate phenotype with genetic value.

claim_map.claim: Sexual recombination generates new candidates; clonal multiplication preserves a selected genotype, subject to identity/health checks.
claim_map.support: Breeding/selection and breeder-to-commercial vegetative material have different roles.
claim_map.scope_limit: Do not transfer maize detasseling, male/female row ratios or commercial F1 seed-production assumptions.

claim_map.claim: Canopy UAV observations can predict root outcomes only against an independent harvest reference.
claim_map.support: UAV study weighed roots; root-image study photographed harvested roots.
claim_map.scope_limit: No direct aerial view of roots, starch, cyanide, internal necrosis or pathogen identity. Appropriate harvest and laboratory assays remain required.

claim_map.claim: Match validation to the intended decision: new clones/families/environments and elapsed time require suitable holdouts.
claim_map.support: Parent-wise, within-population and field-repetition tests answer different prediction questions.
claim_map.scope_limit: Published R-squared or variance estimates are not default simulation parameters.

claim_map.claim: Use traceable clean stock, nursery/early-generation multiplication and inspected commercial stem-cutting lots.
claim_map.support: Official breeder/foundation/certified chain plus pathogen indexing and traceability.
claim_map.scope_limit: Vietnam class names, release/registration requirements, assay panels and authority acceptance remain to be checked locally.

claim_map.claim: Disease scouting, genotype identity, laboratory pathogen status and harvested-root quality are separate records.
claim_map.support: The underlying measurement and health-system roles differ.
claim_map.scope_limit: This is an evidence-based design requirement, not a validated disease diagnostic workflow or a declaration of Vietnamese pathogen prevalence.

claim_map.claim: Use flowering, seed set, clonal evaluation and multiplication as event-defined stages without invented durations or empirical variance.
claim_map.support: Documented biological/operational stages provide a framework.
claim_map.scope_limit: Local durations, survival, multiplication ratios, costs and covariance components require observations or explicit scenario labels.

open_requirements: Freeze matching FASTA/GFF/version/checksum before any real variant or genomic-coordinate analysis.
Obtain Vietnamese cassava target-product profiles, environment/management observations, trial pedigree/genotypes and harvest/laboratory outcomes.
Verify local release, nursery/multiplication and planting-material health/certification requirements with current authoritative sources.
Fit variance/covariance, genotype-by-environment and observation-error models from suitable data or identify every numerical input as a scenario.
